name: agent-sessions
description: Let AI agents check an app's admin panel or signed-in pages in production: a separate agent user, an hour's session minted straight into the database (by a command in the app's container, or, for apps on Vercel, by a SQL function in the database's container plus a one-time key the app signs), a read-only rule, an audit table, revocation, and an ssh helper that loads the cookie into Playwright or curl without ever printing it. Better Auth, Supabase and Auth.js.
